notes.title: 1.2 Director's Cut Update
notes.content:
The [b]Director's Cut[/b] update of [i]The Prospector Odyssey[/i] adds a new mode, comprising of a completely different way of playing the game; transforming the experience into a classic-style survival horror:
[list]
[*]Fixed/dynamic camera angles
[*]Tank controls
[*]Limited saves requiring the use of "data discs" which are a finite resource (Optional)
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.content:
The 1.1 update replaces the inventory and container / storage systems with completely rebuilt versions - this version is therefore [i]not[/i] compatible with earlier save files and will require starting a new game

1.1 Update in full:
[list]
[*] Rebuilt inventory and storage / container systems - now more responsive to keyboard navigation
[*] New (Easy) difficulty mode that links all storage boxes on Gemini Station
[*] Minor animation edits to spacesuit locomotion
[*] Additional / altered enemy placements
[*] Fixed invisible deployed pipe bomb IED bug
[*] Fixed Refuelling Station airlock scanner allowing IEDs through
[*] Minor texture edits
[/list]
